applicability.goal_shape: A natural isomorphism up ≅ down (or any isomorphism between two functors) assembled as a calc chain of isomorphisms whose substantive steps are justified by an exactness lemma about a short complex fed to cokerIsoCoim / kerIsoIm.
applicability.use_when: The target isomorphism factors through a short exact sequence (or short complex) the file has already built, so the coker and kernel isomorphisms plus one exactness lemma per link supply the content, and the remaining links are structural (associators, whiskering).
applicability.avoid_when: The chain is a plain equality rewrite with no per-step content lemma, the exactness lemmas are not yet proved (they are the real work), or the steps need genuinely different arguments that do not factor through one short complex.

consequences: The chain creates one obligation per substantive link: exact_periodSeq₁ (closing the cokerIsoCoim step) and exact_periodSeq₂ (closing the kerIsoIm step), plus the two functors that package the short complexes. The three structural links (Functor.associator twice, Functor.isoWhiskerLeft once) are discharged by the library, not by project lemmas. The exactness lemmas in turn reduce to the kernel-range equalities Representation.map₁_ker and Representation.map₂_range, which carry the finiteness and cyclicity of G; if either were false the corresponding calc step would not close.
